Title: **YouTube Finally Changed Its Algorithm...What To Do Now?**

YouTube has completely upgraded its recommendation system using Large Recommender Models (LRMs) and Semantic IDs powered by Gemini AI. The algorithm no longer relies on your title or tags—it is now tokenising and decoding every single frame, audio transcript, and editing style of your video.
